entities.summary: Gaspare Maria Paoletti was an Italian Neoclassical sculptor and architect, active mainly in his native Florence. Among his works are the Palazzina della Meridiana (1775), the White Hall (1776), and the Museum of La Specola, all attached to the Palazzo Pitti. He worked extensively at the Villa di Poggio Imperiale (1776-1783).
